# Project SuperDex > A unified platform for dexterous manipulation research **Welcome to Project SuperDex.** SuperDex brings together a purpose-built physics engine, robotics authoring tools, and a scalable reinforcement learning interface in a unified simulation platform, with VR-based teleoperation and additional capabilities planned for future releases. Visit the [Project SuperDex website](https://projectsuperdex.com/) for more. | Threaded Screw | Manipulation | | :-: | :-: | | | | ## Building blocks - **SuperDex Physics** — A contact-first physics engine purpose-built for tactile manipulation, and applicable wherever stable contact and accurate sensing matter. This is the simulation backbone of Project SuperDex. - **SuperDex Robotics** — A robotics SDK that provides robot definitions and composition, controllers, sensors, actuators, and the framework that aggregates them into complete simulation configs. - **SuperDex Studio** — A lightweight desktop GUI authoring and visualization application for creating, editing, and validating the simulation assets — robots, meshes, task prefabs, and scenes. - **SuperDex Lab** — The simulation harness that abstracts the Markov decision process and dynamics-constrained-optimization underpinning RL, MPC, and system-ID. --- ## Gallery The following videos were recorded in real-time using SuperDex Teleop (available in Q4 2026). | Soft Sponge | Fruit Bag | | :-: | :-: | | | | | Cereal Box | Rope Braid | | | | | Contact Viz | Puzzle Cube | | | | | Compose Bots | Soft Fingertips | | | | --- ## SuperDex Studio SuperDex Studio is the desktop application where you turn raw CAD and robot descriptions into native SuperDex Assets - bots, prefabs, and scenes. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：SuperDex 是一个统一仿真平台，由四个模块组成：面向触觉操作的 contact-first 物理引擎 SuperDex Physics、提供机器人定义/控制器/传感器/执行器的 SDK SuperDex Robotics、用于创作与验证机器人/网格/任务预制体/场景的桌面 GUI SuperDex Studio，以及抽象 MDP 与动力学约束优化以支撑 RL/MPC/System-ID 的仿真框架 SuperDex Lab，并计划通过 VR 遥操作提供数据采集能力。


# 一、动机

> 现有仿真平台多面向刚体通用物理，缺乏以接触与触觉为中心的物理引擎和配套的机器人创作/强化学习工具链，难以支撑灵巧操作（如拧螺丝、绳结、软体抓取）这类对稳定接触与精确传感高度敏感的研究。


# 二、方法

> SuperDex 是一个统一仿真平台，由四个模块组成：面向触觉操作的 contact-first 物理引擎 SuperDex Physics、提供机器人定义/控制器/传感器/执行器的 SDK SuperDex Robotics、用于创作与验证机器人/网格/任务预制体/场景的桌面 GUI SuperDex Studio，以及抽象 MDP 与动力学约束优化以支撑 RL/MPC/System-ID 的仿真框架 SuperDex Lab，并计划通过 VR 遥操作提供数据采集能力。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文为项目主页介绍，未给出任何量化实验结果；可确认的是平台已能实时演示 Threaded Screw、Soft Sponge、Fruit Bag、Cereal Box、Rope Braid、Puzzle Cube、Compose Bots、Soft Fingertips 及接触可视化等任务，SuperDex Teleop 计划于 2026 年 Q4 发布，SuperDex Lab 仅为 early preview。


# 四、对我的启发

> 亮点是把「接触优先的物理引擎 + 资产创作 GUI + RL/MPC 抽象层」整合为同一技术栈，思路对灵巧操作与触觉仿真研究有参考价值；但当前无开源代码、无基准与定量评测、Teleop 与 Lab 均未正式发布，实际物理精度与 sim-to-real 表现仍待验证。
